name: Lesson 1: Scanning
descriptionHtml:
Scanning is one of the most important techniques in reading a passage. When scanning, you look only for a specific fact or piece of information without reading everything. Here, we concentrate on how to scan to effectively deal with specific information questions in the TOEIC Part 7. 

1. Question type

In this section, you are asked to read different passages and then answer specific information questions related to them by using the technique of scanning. 

 

2. Guide to answer

- Read questions and underline the keywords.

- Scan the passage to look for the information needed.

- Choose the correct answer.
